description.value: Round Table Pizza Garden City is a family-owned Richmond franchise operating exclusively as a delivery and takeout business for over 20 years, with no dine-in seating. Voted Best Late Night Eats in Richmond by Richmond News, it offers an unusually diverse menu that includes a dedicated Chinese-language menu, a Vegetarian Special, and specialty crusts including gluten-free and cauliflower-based keto options. The restaurant also handles corporate and event catering for the greater Vancouver area.
